subject: financial-literacy
instructions: Use only the fictional or supplied figures. Do not disclose household income, accounts, balances, or spending.
Show computations for fixed items and explain the tradeoff or decision for open items.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain career and education pathways in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of wages salary commissions and self-employment.
Apply gross pay deductions and net pay in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving benefits and total compensation; correct it and explain why.
Connect career and education pathways with entrepreneurship and irregular income. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Compare three fictional career pathways using income, education cost, time, benefits, interests, and uncertainty.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated accuracy or fidelity criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated evidence and reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated application or performance criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated checking and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed.
